name: airtable-api
description: Airtable via the official Web API: bases and schemas, list/find/get records, create, update and upsert records

nodes.title: List bases
nodes.description: List the Airtable bases the token can access (id, name, permission level), up to 1000 per page.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get base schema
nodes.description: Get a base's tables with their fields (names, ids, types, select options) and views.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List records
nodes.description: List records of an Airtable table, optionally filtered by an Airtable formula, sorted, limited to a view or fields; one page at a time.

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

view.description: View name or id: only its records, in its order unless `sort` is given

fields.description: Only return these fields (names or ids)

max_records.description: Stop after this many records in total, across pages

return_fields_by_field_id.description: Key `fields` by field id instead of name

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Find records
nodes.description: Find records whose fields equal (or contain) given values, e.g. where {"Email": "a@b.co"}. The formula is built with safe escaping; it is returned as `filter_by_formula`.

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

view.description: View name or id: only its records, in its order unless `sort` is given

fields.description: Only return these fields (names or ids)

max_records.description: Stop after this many records in total, across pages

return_fields_by_field_id.description: Key `fields` by field id instead of name

where.description: Conditions {"Field name": value}, all must match; value is text, a JSON number, a JSON boolean (true, not "true") or null (field is empty). No backslashes in names or values

match.description: How text values compare: exact, case_insensitive, or contains (case-insensitive)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get record
nodes.description: Get one Airtable record by id.

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create records
nodes.description: Create up to 10 records: [{"fields": {...}}]. Never retried after an unknown outcome.

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

typecast.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the field type (e.g. create missing select options). Workflow nodes only: agent tool calls always send false

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update records
nodes.description: Update fields of up to 10 records by id (PATCH: other fields are kept): [{"id": "rec...", "fields": {...}}].

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

typecast.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the field type (e.g. create missing select options). Workflow nodes only: agent tool calls always send false

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Upsert records
nodes.description: Update or create up to 10 records, matched on 1-3 fields (e.g. Email): no match creates, one match updates, several fail. Every record needs a non-empty value for each merge field.

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

fields_to_merge_on.description: 1-3 fields (text, number, select or date) that identify a record

typecast.description: Let Airtable convert strings to the field type (e.g. create missing select options). Workflow nodes only: agent tool calls always send false

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete records
nodes.description: Delete up to 10 records by id. Workflow node only (agents cannot delete).

table.description: Table name or id ("tbl..."; ids survive renames)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Airtable API request
nodes.description: Call any Airtable API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/meta/whoami". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/meta/whoami"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
